messages:
deploy-bot: config-only rollout requested by @ana: cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01. change window 22:45-23:00 UTC. plan: canary 3% for 15m -> ramp to 25% if stable. observability hooks + smoke tests enabled.

ana: pushing routing weight tweaks + tighter microbatch to reduce median latency spikes, no model changes.

devin: can you paste the config diffs?

ana: here it is:
```json
{
  \"routing_policy\": \"weighted-latency-3\",
  \"timebuffer_ms\": 90,
  \"batching\": { \"max_batch_size\": 16, \"microbatch_ms\": 5, \"max_tokens\": 1024 },
  \"timeouts_ms\": { \"request\": 2800, \"token\": 60 },
  \"limits\": { \"tenant_qps\": 40, \"global_qps\": 18000 },
  \"kv_cache\": { \"enabled\": true, \"ttl_ms\": 300000 }
}
```

rebecca: rollback criteria? also add canary-specific smoke that asserts `x-serving-cfg: cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01`.

ana: rollback if p99 > baseline + 50ms for 2m OR error-rate > 2% for 3m OR synthetic spike fails 3 consecutive pings. abort on coldstart tail > 30%.

sre-bot: observability checklist posted:
- synthetic spike every 60s to canary tenants
- track p50/p95/p99 on /v1/text/generate and kv_cache hitratio
- alert if cost-units/token increases > 10%
Link: https://dash.internal/canary/cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01

devin: adding smoke script to deploy-bot: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code} %{time_total}\" -H \"x-tenant: canary\" -H \"x-assert-cfg: cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01\" https://api.redwood/v1/text/generate?s=hi` then check 200 and time < 350ms. committing to infra.

ana: starting canary now, pushing config to 3% cohort.

deploy-bot: deploy started by ana at 2026-03-21T22:45:08Z. canary_fraction: 0.03. change-id: cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01. observability hooks: enabled.

sre-bot: first 3 minutes: p50 down 5ms, p95 ~ baseline + 10ms, p99 ~ baseline + 12ms. errors 0.05%. kv cache hitratio unchanged. :eyes:

rebecca: nice. holding 15m then ramp if stable.

ana: ramp plan: + to 10% at +8m, to 25% at +15m. will pause if any rollback signal trips.

deploy-bot: ramp to 10% executed at 2026-03-21T22:53:20Z.

sre-bot: after 10% ramp p99 shows small drift +20ms, error 0.08%. still within thresholds. kvcache hitratio steady.

devin: running smoke loop now. all canary smoke tests returning 200 and header `x-serving-cfg` matches.

deploy-bot: ramp to 25% executed at 2026-03-21T23:00:10Z per plan.

sre-bot: within 90s of 25% ramp, p99 jumped to baseline + 65ms, sustained ~3m, error-rate climbed to 1.9% on a subset of tenants.

rebecca: that's above p99 threshold (50ms for 2m). suggest immediate rollback to previous config.

ana: initiating rollback. unpinning cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01 and reapplying previous routing config.

deploy-bot: rollback started by ana at 2026-03-21T23:04:12Z. reverting to prior config. traffic back to baseline within 45s.

sre-bot: post-rollback metrics: p99 and error rate returned to baseline within 2m. synthetic tests green.

devin: collecting logs for canary slice where errors spiked, looks like certain tenants experienced repeated circuit hops due to new latency-weighted tie-breaker under mid-burst conditions. attaching sample logs to ticket INC-4567.

ana: notes for follow-up: modify routing tie-breaker to prefer cache-local replicas for small requests and re-run smaller canary after patch. not a model/regression, config logic edge-case.

rebecca: update CHANGELOG: `cfg-2026-04-slim-surge-01 attempted - routing policy tweak; rolled back due to p99 regression on subset of tenants. follow-up patch planned.`

deploy-bot: thread closed by ana at 2026-03-21T23:07:05Z. keeping ticket open for fix and reattempt. thanks team.
